description: List supported effects with the metadata needed to select an effect and create an effect task. Each effect includes a default image_url and default_music_id you can use directly.
name: list_effects

effects.description: Supported effects with the metadata needed to create an effect task.

default_music_id.description: Default music ID to pass to generate_effect.music_id.

image_url.description: Default cover image URL for generate_effect.reference_image_urls[0]. You may also replace it with a single uploaded image URL from upload_image.

preview_video_url.description: Preview video URL for the effect.

message.description: A human-readable summary of the retrieved effects.

success.description: Whether the effects list was retrieved successfully.
